assertions.text: Creates a local annotated backup tag before the rebase and does not push it
Asks via AskUserQuestion, showing the exact git rebase origin/main command, before running the rebase
Runs no git merge (trial or plain) and creates no merge commit
Presents a per-file resolution plan and confirms it via AskUserQuestion before editing either conflicted file
Does not re-ask whether the user wants conflicts resolved or which skill to use, beyond the history-rewrite confirmations and the resolution plan
